corrections_to_claim: 434 -> 419 core wallets (h15-19); the 15 h1-34 stragglers are honest ladderers/whales holding 0.56 pts-% (3 of 4 checked have nonce 154-1346 and DeFi/bridge history). Core = 15.61% of points, 338 unflagged (80.7%) holding 12.62%.
At least 1, likely 2 first-ring wallets are not the operator: 0x6a44da75 (96.012) and probably 0x1a241ad8 (96.43; both non-0.1-multiples). 385/387.

"40 linear peel chains" understates it: the 40/87 chain split is a cache artifact of FIRST-funder resolution; on-chain every sampled head is fed by a ring tail. It is ONE serial lump (333/419 consecutive ring deposits exactly 2 blocks apart, only 3 gaps <2 blocks, 236 min at 33.8 s/hop) plus a 32-wallet 1.6-1.7 ETH dry run at h15.
Priority fee: 290/349 sub-milligwei (range 1 wei .. 0.6 gwei; 10 at exactly 1 wei), not a clean 0.0003-0.001 band.

Suggested fix tolerance: funding lump 101.9-102.77 vs deposits 95.2-100.1 -> ratio 1.018-1.080; a +-5% window on (deposit+gas) would miss roughly half the hops. Use funding in [deposit, deposit*1.10] within 3 blocks, or match on the FORWARDED amount (in == out within 0.02 ETH) instead.
strongest_supported_claim: One operator passed a single ~102 ETH lump serially through 419 wallets (h15-19, 2026-08-17 11:5x-15:5x UTC), each depositing a randomized 95.2-100.1 ETH (0.1 ETH grid) and forwarding the lump 12 s later; 194 fresh nonce-0 wallets + ~155 pre-aged wallets with byte-identical 10-tx warm-up scripts; gas leftovers swept 08-17..08-21 to chain member 0x2135c4c6 which settles with 0xbc214bc9 (unflagged contributor; also first funder of aged chain member 0x1c85cc7a). 15.6% of all points; 338 wallets / 12.6% of points sit in the published clean list; sybilkit catches 81 (9 clusters) only where a round-amount window happens to contain two consecutive hops.
